newsitem.title: USA: Supertyphoon threatens shipping in Philippine Sea.
newsitem.headline: Supertyphoon threatens shipping in Philippine Sea.

text.p: Supertyphoon Violet is a major threat to shipping in the Philippine Sea, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Violet, with 150 mph winds, is near 20n/126e and moving to the north northwest at about seven mph. It will maintain intensity over the next 24 hours before slowly weakening.
Late Tuesday, or early Wednesday local time, the storm may near Okinawa, Japan, as a major typhoon.
Typhoon Tom, with 85 mph winds, is moving away from the Mariana Islands. It is in the western Pacific near 22n/145e and moving north at 9 mph.
